name: github-style-markdown-preview
description: View Markdown files like on GitHub with dark/light mode toggle, auto-update, browser preview, and customizable settings.

github-style-markdown-preview.autoOpen.description: Automatically open preview when a markdown file is opened

github-style-markdown-preview.updateDela.description: Delay in milliseconds before updating preview after editing (0 = instant update)

github-style-markdown-preview.protectPre.description: Protect the preview column from other files. When enabled, the preview uses a dedicated column and other files opened in that column will be moved to the first column.

github-style-markdown-preview.openInBrow.description: Open preview in external browser instead of VS Code webview panel. The preview will update automatically as you edit the file.

github-style-markdown-preview.maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the content in the preview (in pixels). Use 'auto' for full width. Default GitHub width is 980px.
github-style-markdown-preview.maxWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum width of the content in the preview (in pixels). Use `auto` for full width. **Default GitHub width is 980px.**

github-style-markdown-preview.enableEmoj.description: Enable emoji rendering (e.g., :smile:, :heart:). Applies to both IDE and browser previews.

github-style-markdown-preview.enableBrea.description: Convert single line breaks to HTML line breaks (similar to GitHub behavior). Applies to both IDE and browser previews.

github-style-markdown-preview.closeOnFil.description: Automatically close preview when the markdown file is closed (IDE preview only).

github-style-markdown-preview.focusEdito.description: Focus the editor after opening the preview, allowing you to continue editing (IDE preview only).

github-style-markdown-preview.openPrevie.description: ⚠️ INFORMATIONAL ONLY: Default keyboard shortcut is 'Ctrl+Alt+P' (or 'Cmd+Opt+P' on Mac). To customize, go to File > Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+K Ctrl+S) and search for 'Open Markdown Preview'. This setting does not change the actual keybinding - it's for reference only.
github-style-markdown-preview.openPrevie.markdownDescription: ⚠️ **INFORMATIONAL ONLY**: Default keyboard shortcut is `Ctrl+Alt+P` (or `Cmd+Opt+P` on Mac). **To customize:** Go to `File > Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts` (or `Ctrl+K Ctrl+S`) and search for `Open Markdown Preview`. **This setting does not change the actual keybinding** - it's for reference only.

scripts.compile-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package-web: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
